categories.main_business_segments: Hefei Chipmore Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit advanced packaging and testing industry. Its main business segments include packaging and testing services for display driver chips, power management chips, and RF front-end chips. The company also focuses on advanced bump manufacturing technologies and wafer-level chip scale packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies in bump manufacturing such as gold bumping, copper pillar bumping, copper-nickel-gold bumping, and tin bumping. It also specializes in advanced packaging techniques including Chip on Film (COF), Chip on Glass (COG), and Chip on Plastic (COP). The production process involves wafer grinding, cutting, testing, and advanced packaging with high precision and reliability standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are integrated circuit design companies (Fabless) and foundries, primarily in the display driver chip sector and non-display chip sectors like power management and RF front-end chips. The company serves domestic and international clients, including major panel manufacturers and semiconductor firms in China, Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Hefei and a subsidiary in Suzhou. It also has a sales office in Taiwan to serve local customers. Its market coverage includes domestic Chinese customers and overseas clients in East Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chipmore operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing advanced packaging and testing services after wafer fabrication and before final product assembly. It acts as an OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced bumping technologies, wafer-level packaging, and testing automation. It invests in new materials and processes to support emerging display technologies like AMOLED, Mini LED, and Micro LED. Strategic focus includes expanding non-display chip packaging capabilities and enhancing production efficiency and quality management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized packaging and testing service contracts with semiconductor design companies. The company follows a direct sales model, providing turnkey packaging solutions and charging for services rendered in bump manufacturing, testing, and packaging.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chipmore is a leading domestic player in display driver chip packaging and testing, ranking third globally in this niche. It competes with IDM companies and large OSAT firms like JCET, Tongfu Microelectronics, and ASE Technology. The company differentiates itself through advanced bumping technologies and localized full-process capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.63 billion, a 23.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 371.7 million, up 22.6%. Total assets grew 48.3% to RMB 7.15 billion, and net assets increased 80.9% to RMB 5.83 billion, reflecting strong growth driven by IPO proceeds and operational expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chipmore emphasizes its proprietary advanced bumping and packaging technologies, high product quality with yields above 99.95%, and comprehensive one-stop packaging and testing services. Its geographic proximity to major panel manufacturers and integrated circuit design firms in China enhances delivery speed and customer responsiveness. The company’s focus on innovation and quality management provides customers with high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective packaging solutions.
